Data:Slnev.connie.agdistis.json.startdescription: Once again, Connie and Agdistis are discussing ouranoscopy. She's had some of her people looking into some of Agdistis' ideas, and her face is serious. 'Much more than an eclipse,' she says somberly. 'Perhaps even a War in the Sun.' [Lesson: Ouranoscopy]

Data:Slnev.connie.aladim.json.startdescription: Once again, Connie and al-Adim are discussing Eva Dewulf and Bancroft. Connie sips from her glass, watching him as he leans in close to recite Bancroft's poetry. [Lesson: Pearl & Tide]

Data:Slnev.connie.arthur.json.startdescription: Connie and Arthur are discussing Teresa Galmier's work on the enigmatic power known as 'Janus', with slightly strained professional courtesy. [Lesson: Watchman's Paradoxes]

Data:Slnev.connie.arun.json.startdescription: Last time, Arun was interrogating Connie about possible connections between Calyptra and Bureau. He's clearly been reading up: this time, he is treating her to a disquisition on his own theories on the matter. She seems to be enjoying this even less. [Lesson: Edicts Inviolable]

Data:Slnev.connie.azita.json.startdescription: Last time they were both here, Connie arranged the purchase of talismanic jewels from Azita. Evidently the matter was a success: now Connie and Azita are discussing the provision of Bureau funds for a pearl-fishing venture… [Lesson: Anbary & Lapidary]

Data:Slnev.connie.chaima.json.startdescription: Chaima and Connie are talking, very quietly, about the seven alukites who comprise the Ligeia Club…. [Lesson: Wolf Stories]

Data:Slnev.connie.chaima.morgen.json.startdescription: Chaima and Connie are talking, very quietly, about the seven alukites who comprise the Ligeia Club….with frequent sideways glances at Morgen, who is smiling a Morgen smile. [Lesson: Wolf Stories]

Data:Slnev.connie.coquille.json.startdescription: Connie and Coquille are discussing recent shipwrecks, and a possible connection to Ys… [Lesson: Sea Stories]

Data:Slnev.connie.corso.json.startdescription: Connie is quizzing a clearly nervous Corso about the contents and history of the book known as the 'Calicite Supplications'… and the recent disappearance of the Bureau's copy. [Lesson: Tridesma Hiera]

Data:Slnev.connie.dagmar.json.startdescription: Connie and Dagmar are discussing a minor religious organisation, the Ivory Dawn, whose focus on Ys has Connie concerned. [Lesson: Pearl & Tide]

Data:Slnev.connie.douglas.json.startdescription: Douglas and Connie are talking shop; the kind of shop that requires them to spill salt on the table after naming certain entities, and not to name others at all, but rather to refer to them as 'the spiky royal one', 'the bluey one with the temper', and 'the glossy one.' [Lesson: Maggephene Mysteries]

Data:Slnev.connie.ehsan.json.startdescription: Ehsan and Connie are discussing the right sicut regale, 'like a king', assigned to the Dewulfs - the rights assigned to Marcher Lords, although Brancrug is nowhere near the Welsh Marches. 'I think Brancrug has at times stood in the Moon-marches,' Ehsan agrees, 'but not in my time. The peril has receded, as it always does. But Ys endures, as it always does.' [Lesson: Maggephene Mysteries]

Data:Slnev.connie.fraser.json.startdescription: Connie and Fraser are arguing about the potential return of the Carapace Cross. Connie, of course, views it as a threat; Fraser, inevitably, sees it as an opportunity. [Lesson: Pentiments & Precursors]

Data:Slnev.connie.hokobald.json.startdescription: Connie questions Hokobald narrowly about recent mephitic manifestations on the Swiss-German border. Hokobald denies any involvement, and argues plausibly that these may be the first signs of the emergence of another Chandler-name… [Lesson: Pyroglyphics]

Data:Slnev.connie.morgen.json.startdescription: Connie asks Morgen careful, neutral questions about her connection to the Red Grail, the Hour of Birth and appetite. Morgen carelessly shares her reminiscences, but she insists that of all her un-sisters, she is the 'least grailsome'. [Lesson: Tridesma Hiera]

Data:Slnev.connie.olympe.json.startdescription: Olympe is pressing Connie on the suppression by the Bureau of recordings of Verro's 'Opening the Sky'. Connie evidently enjoys fencing with her: there were good reasons; is this an interview, Olympe; lot of questions for not-an-interview; and so on. Although when Olympe mentions the word 'Chandler', she becomes a little testier. [Lesson: Resurgences & Emergences]

Data:Slnev.connie.serena.json.startdescription: Connie and Serena debate whether the gods-from-Nowhere habitually dwell Nowhere, are compelled to return Nowhere, or carry Nowhere with them. [Lesson: Maggephene Mysteries]

Data:Slnev.connie.stanislav.json.startdescription: Connie is investigating stories of something described as 'Spinnennebel' - a kind of spider-vapour - which has begun to manifest in Germany and the Low Countries. Stanislav has heard nothing, but agrees it sounds nothing like Hive, nor Nest, nor Chrysalis… [Lesson: Insects & Nectars]

Data:Slnev.connie.visiting.denzil.json.startdescription: Connie reminds Denzil's description of certain recent dreams - the dark wood, the moth, the roots that tugged at his feet. She gives him advice in her most official voice: that he should not cut his hair after noon, and that he should place a coloured patchwork quilt on his bed. Denzil is clearly bemused, but listens politely and nods non-committally. [Lesson: Quenchings & Quellings]

Data:Slnev.connie.visiting.killes.json.startdescription: Connie, recalling that Mrs Kille's maiden name was 'Raveline', questions her closely about whether she has had any dreams of wolves, or experienced any cravings for meat or for loam. Mrs Kille patiently, if wearily, answers no to each question. [Lesson: Stone Stories]

Data:Slnev.connie.visiting.timothy.json.startdescription: Timothy is excited to find himself within conversational range of a senior Suppression Bureau official, and asks Connie a great many questions about the Bureau's activities and its recently increased co-operation with the Church. She answers a number of them and politely bats down others, until he asks innocently 'where exactly is Calyptra?'  - at which point she shakes her head, tells him quietly never to ask about Calyptra again, and changes the subject. [Lesson: Edicts Inviolable]

Data:Slnev.connie.yvette.json.startdescription: 'The language of the Four Quarters.' Connie shakes her head. 'I learnt it out there, before I joined the Bureau. If I talk too much about it, it'll spoil the mood. But here's some pointers.' [Lesson: Killasimi]

Data:Slnev.connie.zachary.json.startdescription: Zachary asks Connie for advice on a plan to manage the development of his condition with tattoos-of-containment. 'I wish you'd come to me sooner,' she breathes. But of course she gives him what help she can.  [Lesson: Inks of Containment]

Data:Slnev.coquille.agdistis.json.startdescription: Coquille and Agdistis are talking contemporary dance. [Lesson: Drums & Dances]

Data:Slnev.coquille.aladim.json.startdescription: Al-Adim and Coquille are fencing again. She asks him outright about the nature of his Longhood; he tells her he 'found his patron in the desert.' He asks her if she is 'Clogg-relevant'; she pretends outrage that he is asking about her age, and will say only that she is less than a century old. [Lesson: Pentiments & Precursors]

Data:Slnev.coquille.arthur.json.startdescription: Once again, Arthur and Coquille are discussing the perils of family, birth, and marriage. Coquille has begun to hint that she would enjoy an introduction to one of Arthur's younger and more eligible relatives. A coil of dark hair dangles artlessly across one flawless cheek. Her teeth and eyes are very bright. Arthur, unmoved as a fortress under fire, repeatedly steers the conversation back to the businesses of blood. [Lesson: Desires & Dissolutions]

Data:Slnev.coquille.arun.json.startdescription: Coquille and Arun have discovered that they share family in the subcontinent from which they have both been exiled.  They gossip eagerly about their cousins' expression of familial traits; their alterations and development; their new-hatched kin. [Lesson: Resurgences & Emergences]

Data:Slnev.coquille.azita.json.startdescription: Once again, Coquille and Azita are discussing the 'temptations of the soul' enabled by the inhalation of aromatic essences. Coquille is piqued that her friend and supplier Giorgiou has disappeared; she wonders if Azita found him to be a troublesome competitor. Azita blandly disclaims any responsibility. [Lesson: Applebright Euphonies]

Data:Slnev.coquille.chaima.json.startdescription: Coquille is describing 'the poetry of serpents' to a watchful, silent Chaima. Coquille's eyes glint like agate; her teeth seem more prominent than usual; even her speech has become more sibilant. [Lesson: Preliminal Meter]

Data:Slnev.coquille.connie.json.startdescription: Coquille and Connie are discussing the rumours about the liaison between Franklin Bancroft and Eva Dewulf, more than two hundred years ago; about Bancroft's departure and the child they might have had. 'It is good to be adopted into a loving family,' Coquille says smilingly, but she will not be drawn on what that means. [Lesson: Sea Stories]

Data:Slnev.coquille.corso.json.startdescription: Corso is trying to impress Coquille with a long bit about the Name known as the Excellency Gnathobasis where he almost, but not quite, suggests he's met it. Coquille isn't impressed. But she keeps smiling, and he keeps talking. [Lesson: The Great Signs and the Great Scars]

Data:Slnev.coquille.dagmar.json.startdescription: Dagmar and Coquille's conversation about the Great Signs and the Great Scars is repeatedly disrupted by Dagmar's attempts to introduce Coquille to a 'very nice Margrave.' [Lesson: The Great Signs and the Great Scars]

Data:Slnev.coquille.douglas.json.startdescription:
Douglas turns to Coquille and shakes his head sadly. 'Warrant out for you. If you leave early I'll give you a head start, but Sergeant Heaton's already picked up your driver at the Sweet Bones. You'll have to try the cliffs.'

He watches as Coquille's eyes widen, waits for the count of three, and says with great satisfaction, 'Oh, no, I was thinking of someone else.'

After that, the two of them get on very well indeed. [Lesson: Surgeries & Exsanguinations]

Data:Slnev.coquille.ehsan.json.startdescription: Coquille is teasing Ehsan about the medical possibilities offered by the influence of the Applebright. He doesn't find it funny. [Lesson: Applebright Euphonies]

Data:Slnev.coquille.fraser.json.startdescription: Coquille and Fraser discuss the Great Hooded Princes' (and Princesses') transition between Histories. He asks whether there were Carapace Cross still active in the Fifth History, but she will not answer him. [Lesson: Pentiments & Precursors]

Data:Slnev.coquille.hokobald.json.startdescription: Coquille is flirting outrageously with Hokobald. His head is tilted to one side and he is staring at her with a furnace gaze that might equally indicate lust or hunger. His mouth is stringed with saliva. [Lesson: Desires & Dissolutions]

Data:Slnev.coquille.morgen.json.startdescription: Coquille and Morgen are locked in an icy war of compliments. [Lesson: Sights & Sensations]

Data:Slnev.coquille.olympe.json.startdescription: Coquille and Olympe are comparing restaurants in Tiflis. Coquille insists that the place has gone downhill since the establishment of the Socialist Republic; Olympe counters that you just need to know where to look. [Lesson: Spices & Savours]

Data:Slnev.coquille.serena.json.startdescription: Coquille and Serena discuss the fabled 'Paths of the Sun' through the Mansus which were reserved for the undivided Sun speculating whether the Sun's fission-selves - like the Wolf and the Madrugad - now walk them. Coquille speculates that if the Meniscate walks them, that may account for some of the stories about the shadow-Mansus sometimes called the House of the Moon... [Lesson: Door & Wall]

Data:Slnev.coquille.stanislav.json.startdescription: Coquille brags to Stanislav about the child-eating topiary of her last father's palace. It's not clear whether or not he believes her. [Lesson: Leaves & Thorns]
